column1: NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS
Registration  of  Title Act, No.  21 of  1998
It is hereby notified that any person having a claim to the ownership or possession or interest to one or more of the parcels of lands re-
flected in the Cadastral Map No. 520815  made by the Surveyor-General under Section 11 of the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of
1998 relating to the village of Nikape (Block 01) or any part thereof, situated within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 539/42B -
Kaduwana East in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Dehiwala in the District of Colombo in the Province of Western should submit
his claim to the undersigned before 26th December, 2019 In the event of failure to submit any claim before the above-mentioned date,
